[monster1/]
    SHORTY.

    MALICIOUS, BUT SILLY. LOVES EATING, NEVER LEAVES HIS FORK, WHICH HE HAS MASTERED TO PERFECTION.
    SHORTY ALONE IS NOT VERY DANGEROUS, BUT IN A GROUP THEY CAN DRIVE DINO TO A WALL AND MAKE MANY HOLES IN HIM.
[/monster1]

[monster2/]
    SNIPER.

    AN AIMING DEVICE BUILT INTO HIS EYE ALLOWS HIM TO SEE HIS ENEMY FROM FARAWAY. ATTACKS APPROACHING FROM THE SIDE, FIRES A BURST AND RETREATS. THE PISTOL SHOOTS EXPLOSIVE BULLETS.
    SNIPER LOOKS SAD ONLY BECAUSE HE DREAMS ABOUT A BAZOOKA INSTEAD OF THE PISTOL.
[/monster2]

[monster3/]
    LONGWISE.

    ONE OF THE MOST MALICIOUS AND ARTFUL MONSTERS. ARMED WITH A CONTINUOUS FIRE ELECTRONIC CANNON.
    AFTER SEEING DINO ONCE, WILL PURSUE HIM AS LONG AS HE CAN. HAS AN ABILITY TO DODGE BOMBS.
[/monster3]

[monster4/]
    BOUNCER.

    A STRONG AND INTELLIGENT MONSTER. FOND OF SPORTS SINCE HIS CHILDHOOD. HEAVY-WEIGHT BOXING CHAMPION AMONG MONSTERS.
    HITS WITH A FIST, BUT REALLY HARD.
[/monster4]

[bonus1/]
    ORDINARY BOMBS.

    BURST SEVERAL SECONDS AFTER BEING SET BY DINO. ORDINARY BOMBS HAVE THE STRONGEST EXPLOSIVE FORCE.
[/bonus1]

[bonus2/]
    RADIO BOMBS.

    BURST ON COMMAND. CONVENIENT FOR LAYING AN AMBUSH FOR WANDERING OR MEDITATING ENEMIES. LESS FORCEFUL THAN ORDINARY BOMBS, BUT MORE FORCEFUL THAN SPRINGING BOMBS.
[/bonus2]

[bonus3/]
    SPRINGING BOMBS.

    DINO CAN THROW THEM LIKE BALLS, BUT THESE BALLS ARE NOT AS HARMLESS AS ORDINARY BALLS.
    MOST EFFECTIVE AT DIRECT HIT.
[/bonus3]

[bonus4/]
    KEY.

    OPENS LOCK, LIKE A KEY SHOULD, NOTHING MORE.
[/bonus4]

[bonus5/]
    BATTERY.

    ALLOWS TO POWER ON THE LASER.
[/bonus5]

[bonus6/]
    APPLES.

    EATING APPLES DINO RESTORES HIS STAMINA. THE BIGGER THE BITE, THE MORE STAMINA RESTORED.
[/bonus6]

[bonus7/]
    PINEAPPLE.

    RESTORES DINO'S STAMINA TO 100%. DINO LOVES PINEAPPLES. THE MOST NUTRITIOUS FRUIT.
[/bonus7]


[bonus8/]
    HAT.

    WEARING IT DINO BECOMES INVISIBLE FOR MONSTERS. HE CAN WALK AMONG THEM AND DO THINGS THEY LEAST EXPECT. BUT THE HAT'S MAGIC WEARS OFF AFTER SOME TIME.
[/bonus8]

[bonus9/]
    WATCH.

    TIME SLOWS DOWN FOR DINO AND HE CAN RUN TWO TIMES FASTER. SPEEDING-UP CONTINUES FOR ABOUT 10 SECONDS.
[/bonus9]

[history1/]
    IN THE COUNTRY WHERE DINO LIVED, THE SUN WAS SHINING ALL YEAR ROUND AND PINEAPPLES GREW SO BIG AND DELICIOUS YOU COULD EAT TOO MUCH AND BURST FOR WANT OF HABIT. BUT SUCH THING NEVER HAPPENED, EVERYBODY LIVED HAPPILY AND WERE NEVER SICK.
    BUT ONCE UPON A TIME A FLYING SAUCER HID THE SUN. IT LANDED RATHER OBTRUSIVELY RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF THE GARDEN WHERE DINO GREW HIS FRUITS. ALIENS STARTED CLIMBING OUT OF IT, AND THERE WERE MANY, SO IT WAS NOT CLEAR HOW THEY COULD ALL HAVE FOUND ROOM IN THE SAUCER.
[/history1]

[history2/]
    THEY DID NOT LOOK VERY AWFUL FROM THE FIRST SIGHT, BUT TURNED TO BE REAL ROGUES. THEY BROKE TREES, TRAMPLED DOWN THE GRASS, SHOOT THEIR PISTOLS AND LAUGHED DISGUSTINGLY. THEY ALSO PUT LASER PLANTS AND BARRELS WITH EXPLOSIVES EVERYWHERE, PLANNING TO EXPLODE EVERYTHING AND BUILD HERE OWN COLONY ON THE RUINS.

    DINO WAS A CHEERFUL DINOSAUR. HE COULD MAKE SOME MAGIC. HE COULD SLOW DOWN THE TIME AND BECOME INVISIBLE.
[/history2]

[history3/]
    BEFORE HE ONLY USED HIS MAGIC FOR PEACEFUL PURPOSES. BUT SEEING ALIENS' DISGRACEFUL BEHAVIOR HE HAD TO GET ANGRY. AND HERE STARTED A BATTLE, THE BATTLE WHICH BECAME A LEGEND.
AND LONG TIME AFTERWARDS DINO-MAMAS TOLD THIS STORY TO THEIR DINO-BABIES BEFORE GOING TO BED, AND DINO-BABIES BLINKED AND STAYED AWAKE.
    THE BEGINNING OF THIS GLORIOUS BATTLE COINCIDES WITH THE BEGINNING OF OUR GAME. REMEMBER THAT THE STORY WE TOLD YOU IS BASED ON THE TRUE FACTS AND THAT THE LEGEND SAYS THAT ALL ENDED WELL.
[/history3]
